item.title: Formal Complaint Regarding Prolonged Gas Works and Repeated Temporary Traffic Lights, 7th November
item.description:
I am writing to express my frustration and concern regarding the ongoing gas works in the area, which have already resulted in over two weeks of disruption due to temporary traffic lights. Having endured this disruption for more than two weeks, the traffic lights have now simply been moved slightly further down the road, where another hole has been opened and a further set of temporary traffic lights installed. I would like to ask why this work has not been completed within the original timeframe and, more importantly, why the gas company has chosen to carry out the work in two separate stages, opening up one section of road and then, seemingly immediately afterwards, moving further down the road to dig another hole. Surely, with proper planning and coordination, both sections of work could have been identified and completed together, avoiding the need for prolonged and repeated disruption to local residents, motorists and businesses. This approach raises serious questions about the planning, organisation and efficiency of these works. Residents and road users should not have to put up with unnecessary traffic delays and inconvenience because of what appears to be poorly coordinated work. I would therefore appreciate a clear response to the following questions: 1. Why has the original gas work taken more than two weeks and still not been completed? 2. Why was the second section of work not identified and carried out at the same time as the first? 3. How long are residents and motorists expected to endure these additional temporary traffic lights and roadworks? 4. What steps are being taken to ensure the work is completed as quickly as possible and that there are no further unnecessary disruptions? I appreciate that essential utility works sometimes need to be undertaken, but there must be a reasonable level of planning, communication and consideration for the people affected. I look forward to receiving an explanation and confirmation of when all works will finally be completed and the traffic lights removed.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Bowes Road, Southgate
